cards.title: Comparisons
cards.text: A Comparison sets two Assessments of the same Items side by side: one side is the Control, the other the Candidate. Its delta is the Candidate's Metric minus the Control's, and its definition states which sign means the Candidate is better. It also records whether the two sides are comparable, how many Items it paired, and its limitations and warnings; the figures give its paired deltas, one per Item, and their spread. Read the comparability, the coverage and the limitations before the delta, and the spread of the paired deltas beside it.

cards.title: Decisions
cards.text: A Decision records the option chosen for a question, with its author, its source and the ids of the records it cites. It is written once by decide and never changed. It applies while the evidence it cites stays as it was; once a record it cites is superseded, it no longer applies, and its reasons say why. Read whether each Decision still applies, and its reasons when it does not.
